title: Fabrication of elastic micro-cavity chips for use in Elastic Resonator Interference Stress Microscopy
protocol: Blow clean glass coverslips from dust with air gun.
Clean coverslips in ultrasonic bath for 3 minutes in acetone.
Clean coverslips in ultrasonic bath for 3 minutes in isopropyl alcohol.
Dry coverslips thoroughly with airbrush.
Dry coverslips on hotplate at 125 °C for 10 minutes.
Deposit micro-cavity bottom mirror consisting of layered structure of 0.5 nm Cr, 10 nm Au and 50 nm SiO₂ on whole surface area of cleaned coverslips in e-beam evaporator or sputter machine.
Clean and dry coverslips with bottom mirror structure as in step 1.
Mix same volumes of the two elastomer precursors.
Stir mixed elastomer precursors for 10 minutes.
Degas mixed elastomer precursors under vacuum for 1 minute.
Spin-coat mixed elastomer precursors onto coverslip with bottom mirror structure for 1 minute (300 µL per coverslip).
Use 3000 rpm spin speed for 8 µm-thick micro-cavities.
Use 5000 rpm spin speed for 5 µm-thick micro cavities.
Bake samples at 125 °C on hotplate for 60 minutes to crosslink elastomer.
Expose the elastomer on coverslips to mild oxygen plasma.
Transfer the oxidized elastomer coverslips into a thermal evaporator.
Evaporate 15 nm Au as top mirror.
Mount silicone chamber onto the surface of the micro-cavity chip.
Incubate micro-cavity chip with protein suspension to apply protein coating to the surface of the micro-cavity.
Ensure the surface of the micro-cavity is always covered with liquid when removing the suspension or washing the chip.
Wash several times with new solution if the medium needs to be changed, without completely removing the solution from the silicone well.
